ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْآمِرِ بِالتَّقْوَى وَ الْإِخْلَاصِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Āmiri bi‘t-taqwā wa ‘l-ikhlāṣ.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, instructor of Allah-consciousness and sincerity!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الْخَوَاصِّ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘j`alnā bi ṣ-Ṣalāti `alayhi min `ibādika ‘l-khawāṣ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and make us, by sending prayers upon him, of Your privileged servants!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ أُولِي الْقُرْبِ وَ الْاِخْتِصَاصِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ulī ’l-qurbi wa ‘l-ikhtiṣāṣ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those of nearness and speciality!
